whetstone.label: Hone the edge
whetstone.desc: A sharper edge and point: cuts and thrusts go deeper (+10% sharpness).

temper.label: Temper the blade
temper.desc: Bronze and iron reforged as steel: harder, holds an edge, chips less.

throwing.label: Throwing balance
throwing.desc: Weighted to fly point first: it can be thrown like a javelin (F).

gemFire.label: Ruby socket
gemFire.desc: Hits set people on fire: 3 s of burning.

gemPoison.label: Emerald socket
gemPoison.desc: Hits poison: slow blood loss and the shakes.

engrave.label: Engrave a word
engrave.desc: Words on the blade that do something (pick one).

thunderPot.name: Thunder pot
thunderPot.desc: Stuns and knocks down everyone nearby. Friends included.

nailPot.name: Nail pot
nailPot.desc: Sprays nails that knock voxels off people.

sandPot.name: Sand pot
sandPot.desc: A blinding cloud. Enemies inside swing at nothing.

greekFire.name: Greek fire
greekFire.desc: Burning oil: it sprays over whoever it breaks on and pools on the sand.

vitriol.name: Vitriol pot
vitriol.desc: Acid: it sprays over whoever it breaks on and eats into the flesh; a puddle that burns the feet.

beehive.name: Beehive
beehive.desc: Enemies who get hit flail around for 5 seconds.

bananas.name: Banana bundle
bananas.desc: Three peels on the floor in front of you.

caltrops.name: Caltrops
caltrops.desc: Spiky floor patch. Anyone walking on it limps. Anyone.

goat.name: Decoy goat
goat.desc: Every beast in the arena goes after the goat.

bandage.name: Bandages
bandage.desc: Stops all bleeding. Used beside a fallen friend, it is his: he is up twice as fast.

wine.name: Wine
wine.desc: Full breath at once. A little drunk for ten seconds.

bola.name: Bola
bola.desc: Wraps around the legs. They fall on their face. Topples a Cyclops.

oliveOil.name: Olive oil amphora
oliveOil.desc: A slippery puddle. Everyone who runs through it eats sand.

garum.name: Garum pot
garum.desc: Rotten fish sauce. Enemies retch and drop their weapons.

honey.name: Honey pot
honey.desc: A sticky puddle. Feet barely move. Bees love it.

smoke.name: Smoke pot
smoke.desc: A thick cloud. Bots inside lose their targets and swing at friends.

mystery.name: Mystery amphora
mystery.desc: Nobody knows. Thunder, goat, confetti, or one single grape.

chickens.name: Cluster chickens
chickens.desc: Six rubber chickens burst out. The crowd loses it.

anvil.name: Anvil
anvil.desc: Heavy. Slow throw. Craters whatever it lands on.

harpoon.name: Harpoon
harpoon.desc: Hooks an enemy and reels them in. Fish of the day.

darts.name: Plumbata (3 darts)
darts.desc: Three weighted darts in one throw. They stick in the voxels.

discus.name: Discus
discus.desc: Bounces off the wall. A ricochet hit pays gold. Can come back around.

bigNet.name: Weighted net
bigNet.desc: A big net: catches everyone standing close together.

boomerang.name: Boomerang gladius
boomerang.desc: Comes back. Catch it with a free hand, or it hits you in the head.

cheese.name: Cheese wheel
cheese.desc: Bowl it. It rolls and knocks people off their feet.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.desc: A clay sphere of Vulcan's fire: bursts in a ball of flame and a shock that throws men down.

telekinesis.name: Hand of Jupiter
telekinesis.desc: Seizes a man (no giants) in an unseen grip for 3 s: he hangs where you look, swinging his arms. F hurls him there; the harder he lands, the worse for him.
